name: R9 Large sea monster fin helmet

system.description:
Warrior Archi class only. You gain the [Aquatic] tag. [Self: Hate Top] You gain [Barrier:10] at the start of each round's Setup phase. This [Barrier] does not overwrite the [Barrier] you are already receiving, but adds to its intensity. A helmet modeled after the Sky-Splitting Dorsal Fin, a symbol of the Sahuagin King. The fin, towering toward the sky, grows stronger and more resilient in accordance with the user's heightened emotions.

Pale Shield Scale [Core Material] (180G) + Bascinet (160G) + Scroll of Underwater Action (Basic) (50G) ×2 + [Magic Catalyst 9] (90G) ×3 + Crafting Cost (290G)
